test_title: PYST 4: Selection Post (Matric Level) - English Language (Held On 28 Jul, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Find the part of the sentence that contains an error:

She adopted a orphan (1) / and raised him (2) / as her own child (3) / with love (4).
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The error is found in part (1) of the sentence and concerns the incorrect use of the **indefinite article**.
 
• The rule for indefinite articles is to use "**a**" before words beginning with a consonant sound and "**an**" before words beginning with a **vowel sound**.
 
• The word "**orphan**" starts with the vowel sound /ɔː/, which requires the article "**an**" instead of "a."
 
• Therefore, the phrase "a orphan" must be corrected to "**an orphan**."

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"She adopted **an orphan** and raised him as her own child with love."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **(2): "and raised him"** – This part is correct. "Raised" is the past tense of "raise," meaning to bring up a child.
 
• **(3): "as her own child"** – This phrase is grammatically correct and uses "as" to show the role or capacity in which the person was raised.
 
• **(4): "with love."** – This is a prepositional phrase acting as an adverb of manner, which is used correctly here.
